text.body:
Yogāmbaramukhākhyāna
NAK 4-258 = NGMPP 119/14
[1r] [siddham] namaḥ śrīyogāmbarāya ||
nāgārjunaṃ praṇamyādau, caturākṣarapūrvakaṃ |
atyantaprakaṭodguhyaṃ, buddhavākyaṃ namāmy ahaṃ || 1 ||
etat guhyapradeśan tu padmasya madhum ālayaṃ |
sṛṣṭena jñānatattvasya, pūrvadharman namāmy ahaṃ || 2 ||
tattvāya vajracetasya, alijñānena paṃkajā |
madhum amṛtasvādasya, tribhi vākyaṃ nnamāmy ahaṃ || 3 ||
sā khalu krodhāhaṃkāra, jñānañ codeti sarvasaḥ |
tilakena tu mārggasya tribhi vākyam namāmy ahaṃ || 4 ||
yā triyānapadaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ, jatmājatmaparamparā |
praṇidhim asṛtasattvānāṃ, buddhavākyaṃ namāmy ahaṃ || 5 ||
paṃcāpacārādipūjā dakṣiṇabhāge sthāpya,
arghabhājanādikaṃ vāmabhāge, baliñ ca sthāpya ||
yogī samāhitahṛdaye catumaṇḍalopari kṛṣṇavajraṃ | kaṇṭhe padmopari kṛṣṇahrīkāram vicintya || || oṃ jihvāsaṃvarttini hūṃ phaṭ ||
tadanu karaśodhanaṃ || suṃ kṣuṃ yuṃ huṃ aḥ || yā dakṣiṇasū hastasū yya jñānaṃ || || smryuṃ hmryuṃ ymryuṃ kṣmryuṃ saḥ || vāmahaste vijñānaṃ ||
jñānena padma saṃpīḍya triśūcyā karam aṃgulī | aṣṭāṃgakaraṇaṃ kuryyāt || || suṃ jihvāyāṃ || kṣuṃ mūrdhni || yuṃ karṇṇanāśayoḥ || hūṃ cakṣu || smryuṃ kaṇṭhe || hmryuṃ bāhudvaye || ymryuṃ hṛdi || kṣmryuṃ nābhau ||
[1v] tadanu trikāyādhiṣṭhānaṃ || oṃ āḥ hūṃ ||
tataḥ sattvavajrīmudrāṃ sarvavastu-adhiṣṭhānaṃ || oṃ smryuṃ sarvasaṃśodhanī hūṃ phaṭ ||
jñānavijñānaveṣṭitahaṃsapakṣavat || oṃ vajrakavace hūṃ phaṭ || kīlanaprākārā digbandhapañjarañ ca yathākramaṃ || ||
sattvavajrīmudrā hūṃkāradhvanipūritaṃ || bhūcchatrā padmaveṣṭitā, svetārocanam ucchritya parivarttyoṣṇīṣa ca || mūrdhni lalāṭakarṇābhyāṃ, śiraḥpṛṣṭhe vairocanādi yathākramaṃ paṃca || oṃ hūṃ aḥ svāhā || śvetārocanam ucchritya parivarttya granthiyogena oṃ ṭaṭ mantraḥ || samatālena vajra tuṣya hoḥ 3 || ||
nāsāgrāvaropitayogī susamāhitaḥ maṇḍalacakraṃ vibhāvyaḥ || oṃ vajrāṃkuśa jaḥ oṃ ākarṣyani hūṃ || oṃ āḥ pratīcchārgha hūṃ || oṃ pravarasatkārārgha hūṃ svāhā || oṃ pravarapādyam pratīccha svāhā || oṃ pravarācamanam pratīcchaḥ svāhā || || vajrapāśa, vajrasphoṭa, vajrāveśa hoḥ || || oṃ supriye gandhe hūṃ svāhā || oṃ śriyajapuṣpe hūṃ svāhā ||
oṃ aḥ vajradhūpe hūṃ svāhā || oṃ kṣuṃ vajradīpe hūṃ svāhā || oṃ guṃ svāhā || oṃ i svāhā || balinaivyadya || svasvamantreṇa ḍhaukayet lāśyādyaṣṭavidhā pūjā || ||
[2r] svāgata dharmma anaghalā, amalāpagatena, gāhāgāhavivajia paṇamaha tattiae || pecchia sohia dharmma ṇa hi sambhāvaṇa meru, bamhaṇa kurkkuru caṇḍālu ekasahāve khajju || oṃ akāro mukhaṃ sarvvadharmāṇām ādyanutpannatvāt oṃ āḥ hūṃ || || paṇamaha bhāva vimuccaī || nāhaiha aṃga sucālu | doṃdāliṅgaṇa jou || māa vibhūsiae ||
tenā hūṃ 2 tenā te te hūṃ || ||
anādinidhanasattvo, vajrasattvo mahārate |
samantabhadra sarvātmā, vajragarbhāpati mama || vajratattvaṃ ||
ākāśalakṣaṇaṃ sarvva, mākāśañ cāpy alakṣaṇaṃ |
ākāśasamatā yogā, sarvāgrāsamatā sphuṭāḥ ||
oṃ vajra ghaṇṭā raṇita praṇita sarvvatathāgatacittasaṃcodani, vajrasattvahṛdayāvatāraṇi prajñāpāramitānādasvabhāve āḥ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hoḥ ṭarkki jaḥ hor iti || ghaṇṭātattvaḥ ||
sohia vajjam ullālu || tāraï satta vimokkhu
dharmmavimokkhuṃ kajja || ṭhajja susāa dharantu ||
haraṇimakuṭetyādi || ||
tataḥ kamalāvarttapūrvvakaṃ paṃcamaṇḍalake vandanātmakā || oṃ namas te hūṃ || oṃ namo nama hūṃ || oṃ namāmi hūṃ || tripraṇāmaṃ kṛtvā || samayas tvaṃ samaya ho 3 || sattvān sthāpayiṣyāmi nirvṛttāv iti || || [2v] ādiyoga ārambhaḥ || ||
sattvaparyaṅkam ābhujya yogī samohitaḥ | svahṛdi kṣuṃkāraṃ agnisuprabham ātmadehadravībhūtaṃ | bālāgraśatasahasraikabhāgam avabhāṣya || oṃ svabhāvaśuddhā sarvadharmāḥ svabhāvaśuddho haṃ ||
abhāve bhāvanābhāvo bhāvānā naiva bhāvanā |
iti bhāvo na bhāveḥ syāt bhānanā nopalabhyate ||
jñāno ham iti vadet ||
oṃ vajraśuddhāḥ sarvadharmāḥ vajraśuddho 'haṃ || ||
ja ja ja jaḥ vajrasatva avatāraṇasiddhim ahaṃ ||
ha ha ha ha hūṃkāranādasamayo 'dbhavanātham ahaṃ ||
va va va vaḥ vajrasphoṭaguhyodgatadehadharaṃ ||
a a a a aḥ a ho suto sya alim eka sulīlayana hūṃ || varttamāno haṃ ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇa ṣaḍbhujaiḥ pariśobhitaṃ ||
hasitakrodhaśṛṃgāra trinetravadana tribhiḥ ||
vajrapayodharaṃ pāṇaṃ; ghaṇṭhākāmukabhājanaṃ |
bibhrāṇam bhāvayan nātham buddhayogāmbaram vibhuṃ ||
udbhavo 'haṃ mahāmudrā mantra || a ā ā ā āṃ catuḥṣu hṛdgharṇṇākaṇṭhamūrdhniṣu || bhūcchatrā vijñānaṃ śṛṃkhalākāra | śvetādhūmāśaṃkhārocanātrimalābhaṃgāmadhyasūcī kārayet || oṃ samaya tiṣṭha svamī hūṃ svāhā || iti || || oṃ yogaśuddhāḥ sarvadharmā yoga[3r]śuddho 'haṃ ||
[ends 8v1]
śrīyogāmbaramukhākhyāna devatāghorapajikā samāptaṃ || ||
prakṛtyā pañca sāvadya prajñaptyāvadyam eva caḥ |
ya kicit kāyakaṃ pāpaṃ ya kicit mānasaṃ tathā |
ya kiñcid vācikaṃ pāpaṃ tat sarva kṣapayiṣyasiḥ ||
deśayikṣāmi te nātha nāthānām agrata sthita |
kṛtāñjalitaya sph((ī))taḥ pranipatya puna punaḥ ||
atyeyam atyeye tena pratigṛgnantu nāyakaḥ |
na bhadrakam idaṃ nātha na kartavya puna mayā ||
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ bhāvanāṃ ca tathaiva ca |
bhaktahīnaṃ maśuddham vā tat sarva kṣapayiṣyasiḥ ||
pṛṣṭhate na smṛtimārgato vā
pṛṣṭhakathāyogam upāgato vā |
sarvaprakāraṃtā gato hitāya
kurmāmatasra sukhasaṃhitayaḥ || ||
pañcavarṇasamācāraṃ nānāvarṇaviśeṣataḥ |
nirvikalpa nilākāraṃ ekavarṇaṃ tu kalpayet || samaya || ||
